title: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 (RadixArk) on vLLM, DGX Spark
slug_note: RadixArk's NVFP4 checkpoint on stock vLLM 0.32.0 with no drafting: 12 tok/s on one stream, about half of llama.cpp + MTP and SGLang + DSpark on the same box.

variation.quant_detail: NVFP4, 21.92 GB (W4A4 body with lm_head packed to FP4)
variation.revision_note: HF refs/main snapshot served on the Spark during the 2026-11-04 test (offline from the local cache)

engine.config: vllm serve in the vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 image, no speculative decoding, context 16,384, up to 4 sequences, half the memory pool

requirements.notes: Not measured. The lab run reserved half of the 128 GB pool (--gpu-memory-utilization 0.50), which is a reservation, not the model's need. 30 GB mirrors the SGLang NVFP4 recipe for this checkpoint (22 GB weights + KV).

steps.text: Run the command inside the vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 image with --gpus all, host networking and your Hugging Face cache mounted.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (671-677-token prompt, 256-256 output tokens); SR-98 four-engine comparison (same bench script, same prompts, context 16,384 on every engine); vLLM 0.32.0 in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 (sha256:befccf0e7e40), command as shown

caveats: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-11-04) as the vLLM leg of the SR-98 four-engine run. Same box, same script, short summarise prompt: 12.05 tok/s here vs 29.21 for this checkpoint on SGLang with DSpark drafting and 24.48 for the ggml-org Q4_K_M GGUF with MTP on llama.cpp.
No speculative decoding on this lane; most of the gap to the SGLang row is the DSpark draft, which this command does not use.
vLLM 0.32.0 could not load the Qwen3.8 GGUF (it parsed the .gguf as a config file), which is why this lane uses the NVFP4 safetensors.
--gpu-memory-utilization 0.50 reserves half of the shared 128 GB pool up front; that is a reservation, not what the model needs.
